definitions.observation_frequency: Quarterly; interpret annual growth as a noisy cycle measure
definitions.minimum_persistence: One annual print is contextual only; seek at least 12 comparable quarters across three years before routine review
definitions.structural_break_condition: A sustained three-year underlying divergence, or a material historical/method revision, triggers review; one quarter does not
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: A sustained three-year underlying divergence, or a material historical/method revision, triggers review; one quarter does not. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Revisions, cycle position, hours/output denominator differences, industry mix and services measurement
limitations: The admitted -0.2% year-to-June-2026 observation is one annual growth measure and does not test a 1.2% long-run convergence assumption.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Underlying labour productivity, MFP, capital deepening and hours/output revisions
definitions.comparison_basis: Comparable national-accounts and productivity vintages; separate labour productivity, MFP and capital deepening
definitions.observation_frequency: Annual, with quarterly releases retained as components
definitions.minimum_persistence: At least three years of comparable revised observations; inspect hours/output and services methods separately
definitions.structural_break_condition: Review if the multi-year underlying path remains materially away from the convergence path or official methods/vintage change
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Review if the multi-year underlying path remains materially away from the convergence path or official methods/vintage change. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Revisions, cyclical utilisation, capital quality, industry composition and service-output measurement
limitations: Current admitted evidence lacks a sufficiently long, revision-stable decomposition of MFP, capital deepening and services measurement.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Official productivity measurement or IGR model-vintage revision
definitions.comparison_basis: Compare published methodology and vintage notes; do not splice incompatible series
definitions.minimum_persistence: One confirmed material methodology or model-basis revision is sufficient for analyst review, not for a state conclusion
definitions.structural_break_condition: Material revision to measurement, source series, or Treasury long-run productivity basis triggers reassessment
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Material revision to measurement, source series, or Treasury long-run productivity basis triggers reassessment. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Routine rebasing or benchmark revisions may change historical levels without changing the underlying mechanism
limitations: No later admitted methodology or model-vintage revision is present in the bounded evidence.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Registered-period TFR and age-specific fertility rates
definitions.comparison_basis: Distinguish registration-year TFR from occurrence-year and age-specific series; comparable ABS vintage
definitions.minimum_persistence: At least three consecutive comparable annual observations can trigger review of period rates, not completed cohort fertility
definitions.structural_break_condition: Review if low period fertility persists across multiple years and age-specific profiles show no timing catch-up
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Review if low period fertility persists across multiple years and age-specific profiles show no timing catch-up. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Birth registration lag, revisions, postponement and tempo effects
limitations: The admitted 2024 registered-birth TFR is 1.481 births per woman; it is not completed cohort fertility and does not resolve postponement.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Cohort completed fertility and later-age catch-up
definitions.comparison_basis: Cohort-by-age fertility profiles through sufficiently mature reproductive ages
definitions.observation_frequency: Annual cohort updates; completed cohort comparison is slow-moving
definitions.minimum_persistence: Require mature cohort evidence and age-specific catch-up analysis; a single period TFR cannot trigger structural reassessment
definitions.structural_break_condition: Review only when cohort completion indicates persistently lower completed family size rather than delayed timing
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Review only when cohort completion indicates persistently lower completed family size rather than delayed timing. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Cohort censoring, migration, registration and compositional effects
limitations: No admitted mature-cohort completed-fertility observation is pinned.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.comparison_basis: ABS annual NOM definition and revised moving annual totals; compare with 235,000/year technical convention without treating it as a forecast
definitions.minimum_persistence: At least three annual observations under comparable definitions before treating a deviation as durable
definitions.structural_break_condition: Persistent multi-year deviation or a verified statistical-definition break triggers review; one post-pandemic high year does not
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Persistent multi-year deviation or a verified statistical-definition break triggers review; one post-pandemic high year does not. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Moving annual totals, estimate revisions, temporary/permanent mix and policy changes
limitations: The admitted year-to-March-2026 NOM of 292,100 is above 235,000, but is one moving annual total and not evidence of a durable long-run regime.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Visa composition, age/skill mix, temporary/permanent balance and absorption constraints
definitions.comparison_basis: Compare like visa and population categories; separately examine housing/infrastructure capacity evidence
definitions.minimum_persistence: Several annual comparable cohorts, unless a formal durable policy regime change is enacted
definitions.structural_break_condition: A durable policy change or persistent composition shift with independently measured absorption constraints triggers review
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: A durable policy change or persistent composition shift with independently measured absorption constraints triggers review. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Category changes, visa processing, student flows and housing supply lags
limitations: The admitted NOM and population snapshots do not establish visa composition, skill mix or absorption constraints.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Age-sex cohort participation, employment, average hours, underemployment and constraints
definitions.comparison_basis: Cohort/lifecycle series with employment and hours; separate caring, health/disability and older-worker channels where measured
definitions.observation_frequency: Monthly releases as context; annual cohort and hours review
definitions.minimum_persistence: At least four quarters for short-run context and three annual comparable observations for structural review
definitions.structural_break_condition: Review if persistent cohort/hours delivery diverges after composition, underemployment and method are considered
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Review if persistent cohort/hours delivery diverges after composition, underemployment and method are considered. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Survey error, population weights, hours mix, underemployment and Supplementary Survey methodology
limitations: The admitted 67.0% trend participation rate for people 15+ is aggregate and explicitly not comparable to the IGR's structural cohort participation rule.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Business AI adoption, complementary capital, task exposure and organisational re-design
definitions.comparison_basis: Separate adoption, investment, exposure, substitution/reallocation and complementary organisational change
definitions.minimum_persistence: At least three annual evidence sets; adoption alone never validates realised productivity gains
definitions.structural_break_condition: Review when adoption and complementary investment are measurable and linked to later realised productivity evidence
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Review when adoption and complementary investment are measurable and linked to later realised productivity evidence. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Selection bias, self-reporting, task exposure not equal use, displacement and sector composition
limitations: No admitted representative AI adoption, investment or task-exposure time series is linked to the IGR claim.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Measured productivity outcomes associated with AI diffusion
definitions.comparison_basis: Link measured productivity to adoption/investment while accounting for sector, capital and labour reallocation
definitions.minimum_persistence: Multiple years and explicit identification limits; adoption up alone is not evidence that 1.2% is achieved
definitions.structural_break_condition: Review if sustained realised productivity evidence or a verified model-basis revision materially changes the productivity mechanism
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Review if sustained realised productivity evidence or a verified model-basis revision materially changes the productivity mechanism. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Attribution, lags, intangible investment, service output and survivor bias
limitations: The single admitted productivity observation is not AI-attributed and cannot validate an AI contribution.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Project commitment through approval, construction, connection and observed generation/storage/transmission
definitions.comparison_basis: Keep SAID, DECIDED, AUTHORISED, IMPLEMENTED and OBSERVED distinct; connect project identifiers across stages
definitions.observation_frequency: Quarterly project pipeline and annual observed system delivery
definitions.minimum_persistence: A single announcement is not delivery; assess multiple project/system outcomes over several years
definitions.structural_break_condition: Review if verified delivery or persistent delivery shortfall changes the model's implementation premise; formal policy/system redesign may trigger structural review
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Review if verified delivery or persistent delivery shortfall changes the model's implementation premise; formal policy/system redesign may trigger structural review. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Project cancellations, connection queues, capacity factors, curtailment and transmission bottlenecks
limitations: No independently governed AEMO/DCCEEW project-to-observed-delivery series is pinned; no monitoring route is created.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Observed generation mix, storage/transmission availability, system costs, reliability and transport-excise erosion
definitions.comparison_basis: Source-native operational and fiscal measures with consistent coverage; physical damages remain separately bounded
definitions.observation_frequency: Quarterly operations; annual costs and fiscal measures
definitions.minimum_persistence: Multiple annual outcomes or one verified structural system/policy change; commitments alone do not suffice
definitions.structural_break_condition: Review if measured cost/reliability or excise-base changes materially alter the IGR pathway; physical climate damage requires its own observed series
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Review if measured cost/reliability or excise-base changes materially alter the IGR pathway; physical climate damage requires its own observed series. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Weather variability, fuel prices, outage mix, system boundaries and partial damage model
limitations: No admitted independent operational cost/reliability/physical-damage panel is available for this candidate.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Enacted tax settings and formal policy changes versus maintained 24.2% of GDP model convention
definitions.comparison_basis: Distinguish technical closure from enacted law, annual Budget decisions and observed receipts
definitions.minimum_persistence: A verified enacted material policy change can trigger immediate model-basis review; a Budget that merely retains the cap does not validate it
definitions.structural_break_condition: Structural reassessment if tax-cap basis changes or enacted settings invalidate the maintained convention
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Structural reassessment if tax-cap basis changes or enacted settings invalidate the maintained convention. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Announcements versus legislation, future offset discretion and cyclical denominator effects
limitations: The 24.2% ceiling is a maintained policy setting, not perpetual law; no independent current receipts/policy panel is admitted here.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Observed tax receipts/GDP, spending, debt and interest-cost paths
definitions.comparison_basis: Use audited/official fiscal outturns and consistent denominators; separate model convention from realised outcome
definitions.minimum_persistence: Several annual outturns before trend review; explicit law or accounting-basis revision can trigger immediate review
definitions.structural_break_condition: Review on persistent outturn divergence or model-basis change; no inference from one Budget holding a convention
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Review on persistent outturn divergence or model-basis change; no inference from one Budget holding a convention. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Nominal GDP revisions, one-off receipts, policy offsets and accounting changes
limitations: No independent multi-year fiscal outturn panel is pinned to this candidate.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.

definitions.metric_or_observation: Age-sex adjusted program health spending and non-demographic unit-cost growth
definitions.comparison_basis: Separate demographic volume, service mix, price/unit cost and program coverage; compare definitions to IGR method
definitions.minimum_persistence: At least three comparable annual age-adjusted releases; no inference from aggregate spending alone
definitions.structural_break_condition: Review if persistent comparable unit-cost divergence or model/method revision materially changes extrapolation
definitions.review_trigger: Request analyst review only if this condition is evidenced: Review if persistent comparable unit-cost divergence or model/method revision materially changes extrapolation. It cannot itself falsify the long-horizon assumption or promote another layer.
definitions.false_positive_risks: Coverage/rebate changes, program transfer, service mix, demographics and price deflators
limitations: No independent, age-sex adjusted health-cost panel is included in admitted evidence; AIHW source coverage is a gap, not a route.
No probability, score, ranking, or automatic disposition is produced.
